producer_report.summary: Athena now runs each behavior criterion that names real records and gives a `status --snapshot` command on the producer's work tree, after the producer's report and the in-loop checks and before the verifier. A figure outside the stated range, or a list of three or more job ids that all show the same value, is sent back through the existing shared send-back with the command, judged lines and output. Every run also reaches the verifier's brief as a `records-criterion-<n>` entry that says it is Athena's own run and must be repeated and cited. An evidence snapshot that is missing, unreadable, or not readable under the producer's policy ends the job before any verifier, naming the snapshot. It runs only where the `athena-cli` package exists. Added `records_criteria.rs`, wiring in the producer loop, `Built` and `verification.rs`, the `RecordsRunView` renderer and a producer-brief sentence, `records_loop_*` fake-producer tests, unit tests, a CHANGELOG entry and D183. The full test suite, fmt and clippy all pass.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: verification.rs also redacts each criterion's cited commands, like the commands the verifier ran. A UI line `producer   records criterion <n>: <result>` is printed for each run that is not a problem. Problems appear only in the 'sent back' line.

mistakes: The first run of the new tests assumed criterion number 1; the base reading's content criterion makes it 2. I corrected the tests.
I first ran redaction before replacing the state paths, so the output showed `<job>/evidence` instead of the placeholder. I swapped the order so the paths are replaced first.
learnings: The base test reading has one content criterion, so an added behavior criterion is number 2 in records-criterion-<n> names and 'records criterion 2' text.

The redactor rewrites the job directory in text to `<job>`. It rewrote the evidence path in both command output and the verifier's commands_run, but not in a criterion's cited commands, so a cited command naming the evidence path could never match 'seen running' until verification.rs redacted the cited commands too.

SnapExec in_loop reads no check seam, so the records run needs its own argv seam. The seam is consulted while the argv is built, before the slot is taken, so its call count includes runs the slot then refused.
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] already had an `### Added` section, further down; the new bullet went at the top of it.
Real Throughput::text() for a landed fake job includes an 'idle between jobs' line, so the real-text test worked in the core harness without moving to athena-cli tests.
